text:
Noah: Quick handoff for CloudCo marketplace onboarding. Need owners for: IdP metadata, image manifests per-cloud, telemetry EULA line, and private SKU wiring. Who wants what?

Ivy: I can take IdP + publisher portal access. Please send tenant ID and SAML metadata. I'll provision a staging role with minimal perms.

Ravi: I'll own images/manifests. Note: we'll produce per-region manifests and place them in s3://marketplace-manifests/cloudco/. Example manifest entry: `region=eu-west-1,ami=ami-0abc, kms=arn:aws:kms:eu:123:key/xyz`.

Jen: Legal here. Telemetry must be explicit in listing copy. Draft: "Anonymous usage and error telemetry may be collected; no PII exported without consent." Need product to confirm events: start/stop, api_error, sku_redeem, trial_expiry.

Noah: Decision: trials are private SKUs, 14 days, single redemption per account. Ravi, include sku_id and trial_expiry in anonymous event payloads.

Ivy: CloudCo contact is ops@cloudco.io. Uploaded their IdP metadata to the portal and created webhook: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hooks/cloudco-onboard. Staging role ARN will be posted later.

Ravi: Filed infra ticket INF-5099 for CMK support and region manifests. ETA 48 hours. I'll push CI jobs for aws/gcp/azure images and link outputs.

legal-bot: legal-check: telemetry clause template attached. Review required if events list changes.

Jen: I'll add the CMK note to listing copy: "Customers may supply customer-managed keys for image encryption; admin approval required."

Noah: Great. Next micro-check tomorrow 9:30 PT. Post blockers here. :thumbsup:
